name: Honoo no Haramase Tenkousei
source:
Tatsuya Tagami has an ambition of world conquest and the first step of his plan is to make every one of his female classmates pregnant.

[From [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=4737]AniDB[/url]]
translation:
田神辰也怀揣着征服世界的宏大野心，而他伟大计划的第一步，便是让班里的每一名女同学都怀上自己的骨肉。
